label: Bible Study
prompt: Thy words were found, and I did _____ them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
verse: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
note: Jeremiah devoured God's words like a feast — Ezekiel and John both eat scrolls later.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But the word of the Lord _____ for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
verse: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
note: Peter quotes Isaiah 40: the grass withers and the flower falls, but the word of the Lord endureth for ever.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a _____ and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
verse: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
note: A sling and a stone — and the verse makes a point of it: no sword in David's hand.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a _____ plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verse: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
note: Spared like a burning stick pulled from a fire — and still Israel didn't return to God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thanks be unto God for his _____ gift.
verse: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
note: Paul ends two chapters about giving money by pointing to the one gift words can't describe — 'unspeakable.'
